# Vocabulary: technique_category

Research area of a technique or breakthrough.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `generative-world-model` | Generative world model | Learned model that predicts or renders interactive environment frames or states from actions. |
| `llm-agents` | LLM agents | Language-model-driven agents with memory, planning, and tool use acting inside a simulation. |
| `llm-narrative-dialogue` | LLM narrative & dialogue | Language models generating dialogue, quests, events, or descriptions at runtime. |
| `multi-agent-social-sim` | Multi-agent social simulation | Populations of model-driven agents producing collective social or economic behavior. |
| `procedural-generation` | Procedural content generation | Algorithmic or learned generation of levels, maps, assets, rules, or histories. |
| `reinforcement-learning` | Reinforcement learning | Agents learning policies from reward through interaction. |
| `game-theoretic-solvers` | Game-theoretic solvers | Equilibrium computation, search, and planning in multi-agent or imperfect-information games. |
| `neural-physics` | Neural physics & surrogates | Learned simulators replacing or accelerating numerical physics. |
| `differentiable-simulation` | Differentiable & accelerated simulation | Simulators exposing gradients or running massively parallel on accelerators. |
| `neural-rendering-3d` | Neural rendering & 3D generation | Learned scene representations and generators for geometry, materials, and environments. |
| `animation-motion` | Animation & motion | Learned character motion, control, and physically based animation. |
| `speech-audio` | Speech & audio | Speech recognition, synthesis, voice, and generative audio. |
| `artificial-life-research` | Artificial life research | Self-organizing systems, neural cellular automata, open-ended evolution. |
| `math-discovery` | Mathematical & algorithmic discovery | AI systems that find proofs, algorithms, or constructions; and new mathematical results relevant to simulation. |
| `inference-efficiency` | Inference efficiency | Smaller, faster, cheaper models; on-device inference; distillation and quantization. |
| `automated-game-design` | Automated game design & playtesting | Systems that generate rules, balance, or evaluate games and players. |
| `player-modeling` | Player modeling | Learned models of player behavior, preference, skill, or affect. |
